description_en: Queries the list of asset tag rules by using the system configuration, feature settings, multi-cloud configuration management, and asset management rule features of Security Center
description_zh: 使用云安全中心系统配置，功能设置，多云配置管理，资产管理规则功能，调用该接口查询资产标签规则列表
name: ListAutoTagRules

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page.
> Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the first page is returned
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为**1**，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page
